title: Rwandan Genocide
summary: From 6 April 1994, after the presidents of Rwanda and Burundi died in a plane crash, systematic massacres killed a large share of Rwanda's Tutsi population. Killing continued until the RPF took military control on 4 July. Estimates run from at least 500,000 (Human Rights Watch) to more than one million (UN).

uncertainty.note: Start per the UN page; HRW calls 6 April the date the genocide is generally understood to begin. The UN says killings continued in some areas until 4 July.

importance.justification: One of the 20th century's defining genocides, with lasting effects on international law and intervention policy.

numbers.note: HRW concludes at least half a million; its own calculation gives about 507,000 Tutsi.
